title: Root-bound completed conservative seed artifact index
description: The canonical JSON content hash is not authority by itself. Root supplies the exact physical byte SHA-256 to the exporter. Runtime validation also checks every cross-file invariant listed below.

path.description: Canonical repository-relative path; no absolute paths, dot segments, backslashes, symlinks, or escapes. Runtime verifies exact expected path coverage before opening files.

x-runtime-invariants: Exactly one ordered entry for every six-dataset/two-arm pair; exactly three completed rounds and 36 unique sessions; no partial-run index is written.
Known fixed inference protocol hash; all 11 original source files and all 36 coordinated original input bytes match its exact fixed-path lock.
The new exporter script, test module, interface note and this schema are separately byte-bound in files; they are not added to the old inference lock.

Original preparation seal and first request bytes, common paired plan, strict threshold, raw source scores/masks, hard-K3 prior+CTS universe, original tuples/peers, fixed parameters and candidate ordering are checked.

All request, batch, prompt projection, complete direct/grouped reply, state, ledger, raw prediction, complete round record, session-keyed owner, round-keyed owner, and final freeze hashes/relationships are checked without rerunning inference or predicates.

Captured rule results must agree whenever original/candidate/request/whole-row guard records describe the identical row tuple. Repeated identical counterfactual contexts must retain identical captured evidence, without executing predicates.

files contains exactly the independently enumerated required artifacts. Unknown/unconsumed paths, missing maps, substitutions, symlinks and path escapes fail closed without opening an unconsumed file.
The bridge validates every raw experimental bit is integer 0/1 and equals probability > 0.5, then converts only that mask field to boolean.
The only other authorized metadata transformation replaces repair_statuses with a pointer to the byte-exact raw snapshot SHA and field path. Full raw predictions and every state/ledger are retained.
Normalized float64 probability bytes, exact repair list/map and strict logical mask remain unchanged. Source baseline predictions are copied byte-for-byte and EC remains qualified.

Root must explicitly supply the exact physical completion-index SHA. Every bound input is rechecked immediately before index publication. Existing differing output is never overwritten; its exact file/directory inventory excludes extra paths, symlinks and special files. Index and export publication are atomic and exclusive.
No evaluation, model dispatch, outcome-based winner, best-round selection, promotion, or quality claim is performed.
